independent_rework.decisive_finding: ResearchSource and LawChangeProposal omit binding REQ-RESEARCH-001, REQ-RESEARCH-002, and REQ-RESEARCH-004 fields, while ResearchAudit validates only metadata, freshness, duplication, and support links. The 47-of-47 happy path therefore proves an incomplete research source and proposal can become eligible.

required_corrections: Represent and validate one bounded typed source record with publisher, URL, source class, checked date, verified source facts, limitations, and mapped law identifiers.

Keep verified source facts, binding product requirements, advisory practices, experimental hypotheses, and rejected recommendations in distinct typed fields. No vendor capability, advice, hypothesis, or rejected recommendation may become a fact or binding requirement by inference.

Bind the canonical typed source-record bytes exactly to BoundInput path, digest, and byte length; ResearchAudit must reject missing content, noncanonical content, digest or length mismatch, unsafe references, duplicate classification rows, and unsupported fact-to-source mappings.

Preserve and test current-primary-source freshness behavior for mutable capability and version claims under REQ-RESEARCH-003; stale or non-primary evidence cannot support an implementation or release decision.

Require every eligible law-change proposal to carry bounded typed impact, migration, proof, and authority analyses, plus exact source and mapped-law references. An advisory source update alone must remain unable to change active requirement state.

Keep the entire research output non-authoritative. This lease may produce only reviewed proposal candidates and findings; it may not mutate adopted laws, registries, manifests, claims, migration state, or release state.

positive: complete primary source record with canonical bound bytes and all five distinct classification fields
current source and complete proposal with impact, migration, proof, and authority analysis remains non-authoritative but eligible for later root review
negative_and_false_pass: omit or empty each required source field independently
source bytes, digest, length, URL, checked date, source class, limitation, fact, or mapped-law substitution

vendor documentation used as primary evidence when the decision requires a current primary source
omit or empty each proposal analysis independently
complete research records still cannot mutate or claim adopted law
mutation_and_zero_write: mutate-restore of the bound source record rejects
audit and proposal eligibility paths preserve the recursive source tree and Git status
